config.note: DEMO seed data built from titles Brian shared in chat, with made-up 'first_listed_date' values so the dry-run has a realistic mix of stale/not-stale items to select from. publisher/release_year are left null (never guessed) - populate from real eBay item specifics during a real sync. original_price is the price micro-adjustment floor's anchor. ebay_item_id values are placeholders, not real eBay item IDs.
